title: Attestation (attestation/0)
description: A signature over an evidence object, stored outside it (one per line in a .jsonl file). The signed message is the RFC 8785 canonical form of this object without sig.

object.description: The id of the evidence object.

purpose.description: author: I made this. approve: I accept this as the accountable person or body. witness: I saw this at this time.

key.description: Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes, unpadded base64url in its one canonical spelling. Whether the key belongs to the signer is a trust-policy question outside this schema.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature, 64 bytes, unpadded canonical base64url.
